scenario.prompt: Reviewer 2 asks for comparison with a newly cited baseline, questions whether the contribution is novel, asks for an additional robustness experiment, and says Section 3 is difficult to follow. Prepare the revision plan and response structure.
context: The new baseline has not yet been evaluated.
No additional experiment has been run yet.
The manuscript and reviewer comments are available.

required_behaviors: Decompose compound reviewer comments into individually answerable items.
Route novelty questions to literature evidence, experiment requests to experiment design, structural clarity to paper architecture, and wording polish only after substantive changes are settled.
Distinguish completed evidence from work still required before a defensible response can be written.
State exactly where the manuscript will change and what evidence will support the response.
Preserve disagreement when scientifically justified instead of automatically conceding.
forbidden_behaviors: Claim the new baseline was beaten before the experiment exists.
Answer an evidence request with rhetorical wording alone.
Silently weaken or strengthen a scientific claim merely to sound agreeable.
Merge several reviewer requests into a vague generic thank-you response.
completion_criteria: Every reviewer item has a disposition, evidence status, manuscript action, and response action.
Unsupported responses remain blocked on explicit follow-up work rather than fabricated evidence.
